typography.headings: Tracking-tight, font-medium to font-bold. Avoid Inter/Roboto. Numbers must use 'Outfit'.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces with 1px border (border-border/40). No muddy shadows, use drop-shadow-sm for interactive elements.
visual_enhancers.progress_rings: Crisp SVG circles. Background circle uses border color. Foreground uses primary (protein), secondary (fat), tertiary (carbs), and text_main (calories).
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react, 1.5px stroke width for a refined look.

grids.general: Mobile-first standard flow. Use Flexbox for timeline.

layouts.today_page: Top section: Dashboard style summary. Calorie ring in center, P/F/C small rings below. Timeline section: Vertical line on left. Event nodes.
layouts.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom. Backdrop-blur with solid fallback. Active state: primary color, inactive: text_muted.

motion.interactions: Framer motion for sheet modals sliding up, list item entrance stagger.
motion.hover: Not extremely relevant for mobile, but add scale down (`active:scale-95`) for buttons.

component_path.modals: Use Shadcn Sheet component for all 'Add' actions (bottom-up modal is mobile friendly).
component_path.inputs: Shadcn Input, large text size for numbers.

TodayTimeline.description: Main dashboard showing today's progress and timeline of meals/workouts.
layout: Summary Card: Large circular progress for Calories (Intake vs Plan). 3 smaller horizontal progress bars or rings for Protein, Fat, Carbs. Gap to plan displayed clearly.
Timeline: Vertical line. Items sorted chronologically. Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner fixed placeholders if empty. Add FAB (Floating Action Button) or inline 'Add' buttons.
Timeline Items: Time, Icon, Title (e.g., Breakfast). Content: Foods with gram, Cal, P/F/C.

History.description: List of past days with summary.
layout: List of days. Each card shows Date, Total Calories, and P/F/C summary.

FoodDatabase.description: List of foods to search and select.
layout: List of food items showing Name, Cal/100g, Macros/100g.
Form with 4 big number inputs: Target Calories, Target Protein(g), Target Fat(g), Target Carbs(g).

AddFoodModal.description: Bottom sheet to add a specific food.
layout: Weight input (g). Large keypad or number input.
Input for Duration/Intensity or exercise name.

AddOtherEventModal.description: Bottom sheet to add non-diet/training event.

food_breakfast.description: two bowls of oatmeal with fruits

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the app is mobile-first, max-w-md mx-auto if viewed on desktop.
Install Noto Sans SC and Outfit via Google Fonts.
Implement Circular Progress component for the nutrition summary. Use SVG.
Use Shadcn Sheet component for all 'Add' modals to mimic native mobile bottom sheets.
Use lucide-react for all icons. Stroke width 1.5.
Apply 'data-testid' to all buttons and interactive elements.
Mock data should be minimal: 1-2 foods per meal, 1 training.
No horizontal scroll on the entire page.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do not apply universal transition 'transition: all'. Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA standard. Buttons must clearly show active/focus state.
